# Reading the Riviera: Julian Hale's Cultural History and the Places Behind It

Think of the French Riviera.

What comes to mind?

The blue Mediterranean. Palm trees. Elegant hotels. Yachts in Monaco. The Cannes Film Festival. Artists working in sunlit studios. Writers spending afternoons in cafés overlooking the sea.

It's a remarkably powerful image.

Few stretches of coastline have become so closely associated with a particular way of life.

But that image didn't emerge naturally from the landscape.

It was created, gradually, by visitors, residents, artists, architects, writers, filmmakers and the people who built the region's tourist economy.

And before that familiar world existed, there was another Riviera.

Roman roads and imperial monuments. Medieval conflicts. Changing political borders. Religious communities. Working ports, hilltop villages and ordinary towns where most people were not particularly interested in becoming glamorous.

This is the wider story explored in The French Riviera: A Cultural History by Julian Hale.

First published in 2009, the book examines how a rugged Mediterranean coast developed into an internationally recognised cultural landscape.

Its subject isn't simply what happened here.

It's how the Riviera acquired its distinctive identity, who helped shape that identity and what lies beyond the familiar tourist image.

For visitors staying in Menton, the book is a particularly interesting companion.

The publisher biography describes Hale as a writer and broadcaster dividing his time between London and Menton; this is a biographical description, not independently verified current residence. The eastern Riviera features prominently in the published outline.

This guide introduces the book, follows its major cultural themes and suggests real places where you can explore them.

It isn't a chapter-by-chapter substitute for Hale's work.

Instead, it's an invitation to read the coast more closely.

Carnolès museum remains closed and the last checked municipal notice limits the garden to weekends. The published E-1027 visiting season ended on 31 October; no later programme is confirmed here. These cultural stops are alternatives for different dates, not a promise that every attraction is open today.

# Lire la Riviera : l'histoire culturelle de Julian Hale et les lieux qui l'éclairent

Quand on pense à la Côte d'Azur, viennent la mer bleue, les palmiers, les grands hôtels, les yachts de Monaco, Cannes et ses films, les peintres dans leurs ateliers et les écrivains aux terrasses. Cette image puissante n'est pourtant pas née spontanément du paysage. Habitants, visiteurs, artistes, architectes et travailleurs du tourisme l'ont construite au fil des générations.

Avant cette Riviera existaient des routes romaines, des frontières mouvantes, des communautés religieuses, des ports de travail et des villages perchés. Dans The French Riviera: A Cultural History, paru en 2009, Julian Hale explore la transformation de ce littoral accidenté en paysage culturel international. Il s'intéresse autant à la fabrication de sa réputation qu'aux événements historiques.

Pour un séjour à Menton, cette perspective est précieuse. La biographie de l'éditeur présente Hale comme écrivain et homme de radio partageant son temps entre Londres et Menton ; il ne s'agit pas d'une résidence actuelle vérifiée indépendamment. Notre guide rapproche les thèmes du livre de lieux réels, sans remplacer sa lecture.

Point pratique du 4 novembre 2026 : Val Rahmeh est fermé jusqu'au 27 novembre inclus, réouverture annoncée le 28. Serre de la Madone annonce sa fermeture annuelle en novembre et décembre. Le musée Carnolès est fermé ; le dernier avis municipal consulté limite son jardin aux week-ends. La saison publiée d'E-1027 s'est terminée le 31 octobre, sans nouvelle séance confirmée ici. Ce sont des possibilités pour différentes dates, pas des visites toutes réalisables aujourd'hui.

# Leggere la Riviera: la storia culturale di Julian Hale e i luoghi che la raccontano

La Riviera francese evoca mare azzurro, palme, alberghi eleganti, yacht a Monaco, cinema a Cannes, pittori negli studi e scrittori ai tavolini. È un'immagine potente, ma non nasce spontaneamente dal paesaggio: abitanti, viaggiatori, artisti, architetti e lavoratori del turismo l'hanno costruita nel tempo.

Prima esistevano strade romane, conflitti, confini mutevoli, comunità religiose, porti di lavoro e villaggi arroccati. The French Riviera: A Cultural History di Julian Hale, pubblicato nel 2009, esplora come questa costa accidentata sia diventata un paesaggio culturale internazionale. Non racconta soltanto gli avvenimenti: cerca le origini della sua reputazione.

Per chi soggiorna a Mentone è una prospettiva utile. La biografia editoriale descrive Hale come scrittore e autore radiofonico che divide il suo tempo tra Londra e Mentone; non è una residenza attuale verificata qui. Questa guida collega i temi del libro a luoghi reali, senza sostituirne la lettura.

Aggiornamento pratico, 4 novembre 2026: Val Rahmeh è chiuso fino al 27 novembre compreso, con riapertura annunciata il 28. Serre de la Madone annuncia la chiusura annuale di novembre e dicembre. Il museo Carnolès è chiuso; l'ultimo avviso comunale consultato limita il giardino ai fine settimana. # Читаючи Рив'єру: культурна історія Джуліана Гейла та місця за її сторінками

Французька Рив'єра викликає знайомі образи: синє море, пальми, елегантні готелі, яхти Монако, Каннський кінофестиваль, художники в майстернях і письменники за столиками кав'ярень. Та цей образ не виник сам із краєвиду. Його поколіннями створювали мешканці, мандрівники, митці, архітектори й працівники туристичної економіки.

Раніше тут були римські дороги, війни, мінливі кордони, релігійні громади, робочі порти й гірські села. У книжці The French Riviera: A Cultural History, вперше виданій 2009 року, Джуліан Гейл досліджує, як цей складний для пересування берег став міжнародним культурним ландшафтом. Його цікавлять не лише події, а й походження репутації регіону.

Для гостей Ментона це корисний погляд. Видавнича біографія описує Гейла як письменника й радіожурналіста, що ділить час між Лондоном і Ментоном; це не незалежно перевірене нинішнє місце проживання. Наш гайд поєднує теми книжки з реальними місцями, не замінюючи її читання.

Практичне уточнення на 4 листопада 2026 року: Val Rahmeh закритий до 27 листопада включно, відкриття анонсоване на 28-ме. Serre de la Madone повідомляє про щорічне закриття в листопаді й грудні. Музей Carnolès закритий; останнє перевірене міське повідомлення обмежує доступ до саду вихідними. Опублікований сезон E-1027 закінчився 31 жовтня, наступних сеансів тут не підтверджено. Це варіанти для різних дат, а не обіцянка, що всі місця доступні сьогодні.

## 1. Discover the book

Title: The French Riviera: A Cultural History

Author: Julian Hale

First publication: 2009

Original publisher: Signal Books / Oxford University Press editions

Series: Landscapes of the Imagination

Original edition: 234 numbered pages, plus preliminary material

Language: English

Genre: Cultural history / Regional history / Travel literature

Later edition: Andrews UK Limited, 2026

The book belongs to the Landscapes of the Imagination series, which explores places through their history, cultural associations and representation in literature and art.

Hale was a writer and broadcaster with personal experience of the Riviera.

His approach combines historical material with observations about architecture, landscape, social life and the individuals who contributed to the region's reputation.

Rather than restricting himself to the history of tourism, he explores several overlapping cultural worlds.

### What does the book cover?

Its eleven main chapters move between historical and thematic subjects.

They include Roman civilisation, warfare, Monaco's dynasty, British winter visitors, Russian residents, American expatriates, French writers, painting, music, cinema, architecture, gardens and the hilltop settlements behind the coast.

This makes the book particularly useful for visitors who want to understand how different parts of the Riviera fit together.

A Roman monument above Monaco.

A British winter villa in Menton.

An artist's museum in Nice.

A garden filled with plants brought from other continents.

At first, these may seem like unrelated attractions.

Hale's cultural perspective helps reveal their connections.

## 2. The Riviera is more than an image

The central idea of Hale's book is that the Riviera's cultural reputation conceals a much more complicated history.

The region's modern identity is associated with pleasure, wealth and artistic freedom.

But its earlier history involves conflict, political authority and the practical difficulties of living along a mountainous coastline.

### Two ways to see the coast

The first is the familiar tourist perspective.

A visitor arrives, sees the sea, enjoys the climate and associates the region with a particular Mediterranean lifestyle.

The second asks how that lifestyle became possible.

Who built the hotels?

Why did wealthy foreigners choose to live here?

How did railway connections change the towns?

Why did artists arrive?

What happened to the communities that already inhabited the coast?

And how did the image of the Riviera develop through books, painting, photography and cinema?

Hale's account encourages readers to move between these two perspectives.

### Try it in Menton

Walk along Promenade du Soleil.

Look at the Mediterranean and the elegant façades beside it.

Then turn towards the older streets.

Within a short distance, you can move between the modern resort and the historic town that existed before international tourism transformed its economy.

The geography is compact.

The cultural history is not.

## 2. La Riviera est davantage qu'une image

La réputation de plaisir, de richesse et de liberté artistique masque une histoire plus complexe : conflits, autorité politique et difficultés d'un littoral montagneux. On peut admirer la mer et profiter du climat, ou demander comment cette société de loisirs est devenue possible.

Qui a construit les hôtels ? Pourquoi ces étrangers fortunés ? Quel rôle a joué le chemin de fer ? Pourquoi les artistes sont-ils venus ? Que sont devenues les communautés déjà présentes ? Livres, peinture, photographie et cinéma ont aussi façonné le regard des visiteurs.

### Essayer à Menton

Sur la Promenade du Soleil, observez les façades et la Méditerranée, puis tournez vers les rues anciennes. Quelques pas séparent la station moderne de la ville antérieure au tourisme international. La géographie est compacte ; l'histoire culturelle l'est beaucoup moins.

Chi costruì gli hotel? Perché arrivarono stranieri facoltosi? Come cambiò le città la ferrovia? Perché vennero gli artisti? Che cosa accadde alle comunità già presenti? Libri, pittura, fotografie e cinema hanno insegnato ai visitatori come guardare questi luoghi.

Percorri la Promenade du Soleil, osserva il mare e le facciate, poi entra nelle vie antiche. In poco spazio passi dalla stazione turistica moderna alla città precedente al turismo internazionale. La geografia è compatta, la storia culturale molto meno.

## 3. The Roman Riviera: before France, Monaco and Italy

Book connection: Via Aurelia: The Roman Riviera

One of Hale's early chapters examines the region's place within the Roman world.

Today, visitors cross the boundaries between France, Monaco and Italy with relative ease.

But those borders did not exist in Roman times.

The coast belonged to an extensive system of Mediterranean movement, administration and trade.

### The Trophy of Augustus

One of the most impressive surviving reminders stands at La Turbie, high above Monaco.

The Trophée d'Auguste, also called the Trophy of the Alps, commemorates Rome's conquest of Alpine peoples during the reign of Augustus.

Its imposing remains dominate the surrounding landscape.

The monument illustrates something important about Roman infrastructure.

The coast was not merely beautiful.

It was strategically significant.

Movement between Italy, Gaul and the western Mediterranean depended on routes through challenging terrain.

### Visit: Trophée d'Auguste, La Turbie

This is an ancient monument with surviving Roman remains and later restoration; the standing structure should not be mistaken for an untouched Roman building.

The site includes surviving Roman masonry, interpretation and panoramic views.

Published adult admission: €7.

In the autumn and winter season, the operator normally lists opening from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. and 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., excluding Mondays and specified public holidays.

The official calendar also lists closure on 11 November, relevant to an autumn trip. Last admission is 30 minutes before closing. Checked 4 November 2026; reconfirm for your date.

Public transport from Menton requires planning, particularly for the return.

[Trophée d’Auguste: official visitor information](https://www.trophee-auguste.fr/visiter/informations-pratiques)

### A question to take with you

Before the Riviera became a place to escape from the world, how did its geography make it important to the people trying to control that world?

## 3. La Riviera romaine : avant les frontières actuelles

Le chapitre romain replace le littoral dans un réseau méditerranéen de circulation, de commerce et d'administration, antérieur aux frontières de la France, de Monaco et de l'Italie. Le paysage n'était pas seulement beau : il avait une importance stratégique entre Italie et Gaule.

### Le Trophée d'Auguste à La Turbie

Dominant Monaco, le Trophée des Alpes commémore les conquêtes d'Auguste sur les peuples alpins. Il conserve des vestiges antiques et présente aussi des restaurations ultérieures : sa structure actuelle n'est pas un bâtiment romain resté intact. Monument, musée, parc et vues permettent d'aborder cette géographie du pouvoir.

Dernier accès trente minutes avant fermeture. Reconfirmez votre date et le retour en transport depuis Menton, sans supposer une correspondance garantie.

[Informations officielles du Trophée](https://www.trophee-auguste.fr/visiter/informations-pratiques).

Il capitolo romano colloca il litorale in una rete mediterranea di commerci, amministrazione e spostamenti, prima delle frontiere tra Francia, Monaco e Italia. Il paesaggio era anche strategico: il collegamento fra Italia e Gallia attraversava un territorio difficile.

Il Trofeo delle Alpi domina Monaco e commemora le conquiste di Augusto sui popoli alpini. Conserva resti antichi insieme a restauri successivi: la struttura visibile non è un edificio romano rimasto intatto. Monumento, museo, parco e panorama aiutano a comprendere una geografia del potere.

## 4. Monaco and the Grimaldis: a different kind of Riviera identity

Book connection: A Dynastic Record: Monaco and the Grimaldis

The Principality of Monaco has one of the most recognisable political identities in Europe.

Its public image combines monarchy, luxury, casinos and international celebrity.

But that identity developed over centuries.

The Grimaldi dynasty, the territory's changing political relationships and the eventual growth of Monte Carlo all contributed to Monaco's distinctive position.

### Monaco isn't simply another French resort

Its sovereignty matters.

The principality's institutions, history and international identity developed differently from those of neighbouring French towns.

This becomes particularly interesting when travelling from Menton.

For centuries, Menton was associated with the territory ruled by the Grimaldis.

Its final incorporation into France came in 1861.

Modern visitors often experience Menton and Monaco as neighbouring tourist destinations.

Their historical relationship is considerably more complicated.

### Visit: Monaco-Ville

Explore the publicly accessible streets of the old town and the area around the Prince's Palace.

The palace surroundings offer a useful introduction to Monaco's political history.

Then consider making a separate visit to Monte Carlo.

The contrast between Monaco-Ville and Casino Square helps illustrate how dynastic identity and the modern luxury economy became connected.

### A question to take with you

How does a small sovereign state become one of the world's most recognisable symbols of wealth and glamour?

## 4. Monaco et les Grimaldi : une identité distincte

Monarchie, casinos et célébrités composent une image récente d'une histoire dynastique beaucoup plus longue. Monaco n'est pas une station française parmi d'autres : sa souveraineté, ses institutions et ses relations internationales comptent.

Menton a longtemps appartenu au territoire des Grimaldi ; son rattachement définitif à la France date de 1861. La proximité touristique actuelle ne résume pas cette relation historique.

### Monaco-Ville et Monte-Carlo

Parcourez les rues publiques du Rocher et les abords autorisés du palais, puis envisagez séparément la place du Casino. Le contraste montre comment identité dynastique et économie du luxe se sont associées. L'accès aux espaces publics ne vaut pas accès aux intérieurs du palais ou du casino.

Comment un petit État souverain est-il devenu un symbole mondial de richesse ? Cette question rend la promenade plus intéressante qu'une simple collection de façades.

## 4. Monaco e i Grimaldi: un'identità distinta

Monarchia, casinò e celebrità sono soltanto l'immagine più recente di una lunga vicenda dinastica. Monaco non è un'altra località francese: sovranità, istituzioni e relazioni internazionali ne hanno determinato uno sviluppo diverso.

Mentone fece a lungo parte del territorio dei Grimaldi; il suo definitivo passaggio alla Francia avvenne nel 1861. La vicinanza turistica attuale non riassume questi rapporti storici.

### Monaco-Ville e Monte-Carlo

Esplora le strade pubbliche della Rocca e le aree consentite attorno al palazzo, poi considera separatamente Place du Casino. Il contrasto mostra l'incontro fra identità dinastica ed economia del lusso. Gli spazi pubblici non danno automaticamente accesso agli interni del palazzo o del casinò.

Come può un piccolo Stato diventare un simbolo mondiale di ricchezza? La domanda rende la visita più interessante di una semplice raccolta di facciate.

## 4. Монако та Ґрімальді: окрема ідентичність

Монархія, казино й знаменитості — лише недавній образ значно довшої династичної історії. Монако не є ще одним французьким курортом: його суверенітет, установи й міжнародні відносини визначили інший шлях розвитку.

Ментон довго належав до володінь Ґрімальді; остаточне приєднання до Франції відбулося 1861 року. Сучасне туристичне сусідство не пояснює всіх історичних зв'язків.

### Monaco-Ville та Monte-Carlo

Дослідіть публічні вулиці Скелі й дозволені простори біля палацу, а потім окремо розгляньте Place du Casino. Контраст показує поєднання династичної ідентичності з економікою розкоші. Доступ до площі не означає доступу до інтер'єрів палацу чи казино.

Як маленька суверенна держава стала всесвітнім символом багатства? Це цікавіше питання, ніж просто колекціонування красивих фасадів.

## 5. The British Riviera: climate, class and the invention of winter tourism

Book connection: Snobs, Consumptives, and Penpushers: The British

Before the Riviera became famous for summer beaches, it attracted international winter visitors.

British travellers played a particularly significant role.

Some came because they believed the Mediterranean climate might improve their health.

Others were wealthy enough to escape northern winters.

Writers, aristocrats, retired officials and families spending long periods abroad helped create an international resort culture.

### Menton's transformation

The arrival of winter visitors encouraged investment in hotels, villas, gardens and leisure facilities.

These buildings changed the appearance of the town.

They also changed the local economy.

The impressive architecture visitors admire today is therefore part of a much larger history of international travel and social privilege.

### Visit: Menton's Belle Époque district

Walk between the waterfront and the former grand hotels.

Royal Westminster, Le Majestic and the Winter Palace provide useful examples of the resort architecture associated with international winter life.

Some remain hotels.

Others have become private residential buildings.

Their historical importance doesn't mean their interiors are open to independent visitors.

### A more interesting question than “Which hotel is the prettiest?”

What kind of daily life were these buildings designed to support?

Long seasonal stays required lounges, dining rooms, staff, gardens and social spaces.

They were part of an international community rather than simply accommodation for a brief holiday.

The luxury of the guest depended on the labour of many other people.

## 5. Les Britanniques et l'invention de l'hiver touristique

Avant les plages estivales, la Riviera attirait des hivernants. Certains Britanniques recherchaient un climat supposé favorable à leur santé ; d'autres pouvaient simplement échapper à l'hiver du Nord. Aristocrates, écrivains, retraités et familles installées plusieurs mois ont participé à une société internationale de villégiature.

À Menton, leurs séjours ont encouragé hôtels, villas, jardins et équipements de loisirs. Ces bâtiments ont transformé aussi bien l'économie que le paysage urbain.

### Les anciens grands hôtels

Royal Westminster, Le Majestic et Winter Palace éclairent cette histoire. Certains restent des hôtels ; d'autres sont des résidences privées. Regardez depuis les espaces publics, sans déduire de leur intérêt patrimonial une permission d'entrer.

Plutôt que de choisir le plus joli, imaginez la vie pour laquelle ils furent conçus : salons, repas, personnel, jardins, longues saisons et relations sociales. Le confort des visiteurs reposait sur le travail de beaucoup d'autres habitants.

## 5. I britannici e l'invenzione della villeggiatura invernale

Prima dell'estate balneare, la Riviera attirava ospiti invernali. Alcuni britannici cercavano un clima ritenuto benefico; altri potevano semplicemente sfuggire all'inverno settentrionale. Aristocratici, scrittori, funzionari in pensione e famiglie residenti per mesi crearono una società internazionale.

A Mentone, queste presenze favorirono alberghi, ville, giardini e strutture per il tempo libero, trasformando sia il paesaggio sia l'economia.

### Gli antichi grandi alberghi

Royal Westminster, Le Majestic e Winter Palace sono esempi utili. Alcuni restano hotel, altri sono residenze private. Ammirali dagli spazi pubblici: l'importanza storica non autorizza a entrare.

Invece di chiederti quale sia il più bello, immagina la vita per cui furono progettati: saloni, pasti, personale, giardini, soggiorni lunghi e rapporti sociali. La comodità degli ospiti dipendeva dal lavoro di molte altre persone.

## 5. Британці й винайдення зимового курорту

До літніх пляжів Рив'єра приваблювала зимових гостей. Частина британців шукала клімату, який вважали корисним для здоров'я; інші могли дозволити собі втекти від північної зими. Аристократи, письменники, відставні службовці й родини, які жили тут місяцями, створювали міжнародне курортне товариство.

У Ментоні це сприяло будівництву готелів, вілл, садів і просторів дозвілля, змінивши не лише вигляд міста, а й економіку.

### Колишні великі готелі

Royal Westminster, Le Majestic і Winter Palace дають наочні приклади. Деякі залишаються готелями, інші стали приватними помешканнями. Оглядайте з публічних місць: історична цінність не дає дозволу заходити всередину.

Замість вибору найкрасивішого уявіть життя, для якого їх проєктували: салони, обіди, персонал, сади, довгі сезони та соціальні зв'язки. Комфорт гостей залежав від праці багатьох інших людей.

## 6. Russians, Americans and the international Riviera

Book connections: Roubles and Roulette: The Russians and An Azure Dream: The Americans

The Riviera's identity was shaped by successive waves of foreign visitors.

But each community brought different motivations and cultural traditions.

### Russian visitors

Russian aristocrats and wealthy travellers became important participants in Riviera society during the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.

Their presence contributed to religious, architectural and social life, particularly around Nice.

The Russian Orthodox Cathedral of Saint Nicholas offers a particularly visible reminder.

### Visit: Russian Orthodox Cathedral, Nice

The cathedral's architecture stands apart from the more familiar Italianate and baroque buildings of the coast.

Its domes and decorative details reveal the presence of an international religious community.

The cathedral remains an active place of worship.

Respect services and the posted visitor and photography rules. The operator’s October 2026 schedule closes the cathedral to tourists on Sundays from 9 a.m. to noon, during weekday services and during sacraments. General opening hours are not permission to enter during worship. Use the operator’s website rather than uncorrected Google hours.

### American visitors

The American influence became especially visible during the 1920s.

Writers, artists and wealthy expatriates helped popularise a different Riviera lifestyle.

The emphasis shifted increasingly towards summer, beaches, swimming and informal social gatherings.

F. Scott Fitzgerald, Zelda Fitzgerald and Gerald and Sara Murphy became particularly influential figures in the mythology of the Jazz Age coast.

### Visit: Juan-les-Pins

Explore the public beaches and waterfront.

The former Villa Saint-Louis, now Hôtel Belles Rives, has a documented connection with Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald.

It's an operating hotel, not a public literary museum.

The surrounding waterfront provides enough context for a rewarding visit without requiring access to private hotel spaces.

### What makes the comparison interesting?

The Riviera didn't acquire one international identity.

Different communities helped create overlapping ideas of what the region should offer.

A place of recovery.

A place of aristocratic society.

A place of artistic experiment.

A place of leisure.

And, eventually, a globally recognisable luxury destination.

## 6. Russes, Américains et Riviera internationale

Les communautés étrangères n'ont pas toutes recherché la même Riviera. Les aristocrates et voyageurs russes ont marqué la vie religieuse, architecturale et sociale, particulièrement à Nice.

### La cathédrale Saint-Nicolas à Nice

Ses coupoles et décors se distinguent des architectures baroques et italianisantes du littoral. C'est toujours un lieu de culte, non un simple décor. Respectez offices et règles affichées, y compris pour la photographie.

L'horaire officiel applicable depuis octobre 2026 exclut les visites touristiques le dimanche de 9 h à midi, pendant les offices de semaine et les sacrements. Une ouverture générale ne signifie donc pas libre visite à tout moment. L'opérateur précise que ses horaires Google ne sont pas correctement actualisables : consultez son propre site.

### Juan-les-Pins et les années 1920

Écrivains, artistes et expatriés américains ont contribué à populariser l'été, la baignade et une sociabilité plus informelle. Scott et Zelda Fitzgerald, Gerald et Sara Murphy occupent une place importante dans l'imaginaire de cette époque.

La Villa Saint-Louis, aujourd'hui Hôtel Belles Rives, possède un lien documenté avec les Fitzgerald. C'est un hôtel en activité, pas un musée littéraire public. Le front de mer et les plages publiques offrent un contexte suffisant sans pénétrer dans les espaces privés.

Santé, aristocratie, expérimentation artistique, loisirs : plusieurs idées de la Riviera se superposent plutôt qu'une seule identité internationale.

Le comunità straniere non cercavano tutte la stessa Riviera. Aristocratici e viaggiatori russi contribuirono alla vita religiosa, architettonica e sociale, soprattutto a Nizza.

### La cattedrale Saint-Nicolas a Nizza

Cupole e decorazioni si distinguono dagli edifici barocchi e italianeggianti del litorale. È ancora un luogo di culto: rispetta funzioni, sacramenti e regole esposte, comprese quelle fotografiche.

### Juan-les-Pins e gli anni Venti

Scrittori, artisti ed espatriati americani contribuirono a popolarizzare estate, nuoto e incontri informali. Scott e Zelda Fitzgerald, Gerald e Sara Murphy sono figure importanti nell'immaginario dell'epoca.

La Villa Saint-Louis, oggi Hôtel Belles Rives, ha un legame documentato con i Fitzgerald. È un hotel operativo, non un museo letterario pubblico. Lungomare e spiagge pubbliche danno un contesto soddisfacente senza entrare negli spazi privati.

Salute, società aristocratica, sperimentazione artistica e svago: più idee della Riviera si sovrappongono, invece di formare un'unica identità internazionale.

## 6. Росіяни, американці й міжнародна Рив'єра

Іноземні громади шукали не одну й ту саму Рив'єру. Російські аристократи й мандрівники вплинули на релігійне, архітектурне та суспільне життя, особливо Ніцци.

Куполи й оздоблення відрізняються від барокових та італійських за характером будівель узбережжя. Це чинний храм: поважайте богослужіння, таїнства й розміщені правила, зокрема фотографування.

Американські письменники, художники й експатріанти допомогли популяризувати літо, плавання та неформальне спілкування. Скотт і Зельда Фіцджеральд, Джеральд і Сара Мерфі стали важливими постатями міфології тієї доби.

Оздоровлення, аристократичне товариство, мистецький експеримент і дозвілля: різні уявлення про берег нашаровувалися, а не утворювали одну міжнародну ідентичність.

## 7. The French Riviera beyond foreign visitors

Book connection: Natives and Neighbours: The French

A cultural history dominated entirely by foreign celebrities would miss something essential.

The Riviera was already inhabited.

Its towns had their own languages, traditions, economies and social relationships.

French and regional writers contributed their own interpretations of the coast.

So did ordinary residents whose work supported the growing resort economy.

### The darker literary Riviera

Hale's chapter considers a range of French literary voices, including Georges Simenon and Jean-Paul Sartre.

Their perspectives complicate the tourist image.

Simenon's Liberty Bar offers one possible fictional companion to this less glamorous Riviera.

The narrative contrasts wealthy resort life with less comfortable social environments.

It isn't simply an advertisement for Mediterranean beauty.

### An interesting reading companion

If you're interested in this darker literary perspective, explore Liberty Bar alongside Hale's account.

The two books do different things.

Hale provides cultural context.

Simenon creates a fictional world through which the contrast becomes visible.

### Visit: a working market in Menton

The covered Marché des Halles offers an opportunity to experience everyday food culture beyond the grand hotels.

The current market is not a reconstruction of an earlier historical period, but it remains a useful reminder that the Riviera is also a place where people shop, cook and work.

## 7. Au-delà des visiteurs étrangers

Une histoire limitée aux célébrités étrangères oublierait que la côte était déjà habitée, avec ses langues, ses métiers, ses traditions et ses économies. Les écrivains français et régionaux, comme les habitants ordinaires, ont produit d'autres lectures du littoral.

### Une Riviera littéraire moins lumineuse

Le chapitre français comprend notamment Simenon et Sartre. Liberty Bar peut servir de lecture de fiction complémentaire : cette Riviera ne se réduit pas à une publicité pour la beauté méditerranéenne. Hale apporte du contexte culturel ; un roman construit un monde et des tensions sociales. Ce ne sont pas les mêmes formes de preuve.

### Les Halles de Menton

Le marché couvert rappelle la ville où l'on travaille, achète et cuisine. Ce n'est pas une reconstitution historique. Il permet néanmoins de sortir de l'histoire exclusive des grands hôtels et de regarder une culture alimentaire quotidienne.

## 7. Oltre i visitatori stranieri

Una storia fatta soltanto di celebrità straniere dimenticherebbe che qui vivevano già comunità con lingue, tradizioni, mestieri ed economie proprie. Scrittori francesi e regionali, insieme agli abitanti comuni, offrono altri punti di vista.

### Una Riviera letteraria meno luminosa

Il capitolo francese comprende Simenon e Sartre. Liberty Bar può essere una lettura narrativa complementare: non è semplicemente una pubblicità della bellezza mediterranea. Hale offre contesto culturale, un romanzo costruisce un mondo e tensioni sociali. Le due opere non costituiscono lo stesso tipo di testimonianza.

### Les Halles di Mentone

Il mercato coperto ricorda una città dove si lavora, si compra e si cucina. Non è una ricostruzione storica, ma permette di uscire dal racconto esclusivo dei grandi hotel e osservare la cultura alimentare quotidiana.

## 7. Не лише іноземні гості

Історія самих іноземних знаменитостей забула б, що тут уже жили громади зі своїми мовами, традиціями, ремеслами й економіками. Французькі та регіональні письменники, як і звичайні мешканці, пропонували інші погляди.

### Менш сонячна літературна Рив'єра

Французький розділ охоплює, зокрема, Сіменона й Сартра. Liberty Bar може бути додатковим художнім читанням: ця Рив'єра не зводиться до реклами середземноморської краси. Гейл дає культурний контекст, роман створює світ і соціальні напруження. Це різні типи свідчення.

### Ментонські Halles

Критий ринок нагадує про місто, де працюють, купують і готують їжу. Він не є історичною реконструкцією, проте допомагає вийти за межі розповіді про великі готелі й побачити повсякденну харчову культуру.

## 8. Art, music and cinema: the Riviera becomes a creative landscape

Book connection: Finding the Light: Art, Music, and Cinema on the Riviera

This is one of the most rewarding chapters for travellers.

The Mediterranean coast attracted generations of painters, writers, musicians and filmmakers.

Some came for the light.

Others found patrons, friends, affordable working conditions or artistic communities.

The region's association with creativity eventually became part of its international identity.

### Painting and the Mediterranean light

Artists including Renoir, Matisse, Bonnard, Picasso and Chagall developed important connections with the wider Riviera.

Their work cannot be reduced to an attraction to sunshine alone.

But the region's colours, architecture and social environment formed part of the circumstances in which they worked.

### Visit: Musée Matisse, Nice

The museum in Cimiez provides an introduction to Matisse's long relationship with Nice.

Its collections and exhibitions explore the development of his art.

The building is separate from his former residential apartment at Le Régina.

Allow time for the museum itself rather than treating it as a quick photographic stop. The municipal winter schedule is 10 a.m.–5 p.m., closed Tuesdays and specified holidays; verify your date.

### Jean Cocteau and Menton

Menton has a particularly significant connection with Jean Cocteau.

He decorated the town's wedding hall and created designs associated with the Bastion.

His artistic presence demonstrates how individual creative projects can become part of a city's cultural identity.

### Cinema and the Riviera

The Cannes Film Festival is only the most famous example.

The coast has also served as a film production landscape, sometimes representing itself and sometimes standing in for entirely different places.

Menton has appeared in productions including Grace of Monaco, Never Say Never Again and Agatha Christie's Poirot.

These examples reveal another way the Riviera's identity is created.

The real town becomes an image seen by audiences who may never visit it.

### A question to take with you

When we recognise a place from a painting or film, are we responding to the real landscape or to an image that has already taught us how to see it?

## 8. Arts, musique et cinéma

La lumière a attiré des créateurs, mais aussi les amitiés, les mécènes, les conditions de travail et les communautés artistiques. Renoir, Matisse, Bonnard, Picasso et Chagall ne se résument pas à leur goût du soleil. La couleur, l'architecture et la société locale participent aux circonstances de leur création.

### Le musée Matisse à Nice

À Cimiez, le musée permet d'aborder la longue relation de Matisse avec Nice. Il est distinct de son ancien appartement au Régina. Accordez du temps aux œuvres, pas seulement au bâtiment. La ville affiche en hiver 10 h–17 h, fermeture le mardi et certains jours fériés ; vérifiez votre date.

### Cocteau à Menton et la côte à l'écran

La salle des mariages et le Bastion montrent comment des projets artistiques deviennent une part de l'identité d'une ville. À côté du festival de Cannes, le cinéma et la télévision transforment aussi le littoral en d'autres lieux : Grace of Monaco, Never Say Never Again et Poirot utilisent Menton dans leurs géographies d'écran.

Reconnaissons-nous le paysage lui-même, ou une peinture et un film nous ont-ils déjà appris à le voir ? Cette question accompagne utilement les visites.

## 8. Arte, musica e cinema

La luce attirava artisti, ma contavano anche amicizie, mecenati, condizioni di lavoro e comunità creative. Renoir, Matisse, Bonnard, Picasso e Chagall non si spiegano soltanto con il sole. Colori, architetture e ambiente sociale formavano parte delle circostanze del loro lavoro.

### Il Musée Matisse di Nizza

A Cimiez il museo introduce il lungo rapporto di Matisse con Nizza. È distinto dall'ex appartamento dell'artista al Régina. Dedica tempo alle opere, non soltanto alla fotografia dell'edificio. Il Comune indica in inverno 10–17, chiuso il martedì e in alcune festività: verifica la tua data.

### Cocteau a Mentone e la costa sullo schermo

La sala dei matrimoni e il Bastion mostrano come progetti individuali diventino parte dell'identità cittadina. Accanto al festival di Cannes, film e televisione trasformano il territorio anche in altri luoghi: Grace of Monaco, Never Say Never Again e Poirot utilizzano Mentone nelle proprie geografie narrative.

Quando riconosciamo un paesaggio, vediamo il luogo reale o un'immagine che ci ha già insegnato a guardarlo? È una domanda utile durante le visite.

## 8. Мистецтво, музика та кіно

Митців приваблювало світло, але також друзі, меценати, умови праці й творчі спільноти. Ренуар, Матісс, Боннар, Пікассо та Шаґал не пояснюються самою любов'ю до сонця. Колір, архітектура й соціальне оточення були частиною обставин їхньої творчості.

### Музей Матісса в Ніцці

У Сім'є музей знайомить із тривалими зв'язками Матісса з Ніццою. Це не його колишня квартира в Régina. Приділіть час творам, а не лише фотографії будівлі. Місто вказує зимові години 10:00–17:00, вихідний вівторок і окремі свята; перевіряйте свою дату.

### Кокто в Ментоні й узбережжя на екрані

Весільна зала та Bastion показують, як особисті мистецькі проєкти стають частиною міської ідентичності. Крім Каннського фестивалю, кіно й телебачення перетворюють берег на інші місця: Grace of Monaco, Never Say Never Again і Poirot використовують Ментон у своїй екранній географії.

Коли впізнаємо краєвид, бачимо саме місце чи образ, який уже навчив нас дивитися? Це корисне питання для культурної прогулянки.

## 9. Architecture: how the Riviera built its image

Book connection: Building the Dream: Religious and Secular Architecture

The region's architecture tells the story of different ambitions.

Baroque churches.

Grand nineteenth-century hotels.

Private villas.

Casinos.

Modernist houses designed for new ways of living.

Each belongs to a different phase of the coast's development.

### Menton's Basilica of Saint-Michel

The basilica offers a powerful example of the area's religious and political history.

Its baroque architecture belongs to a time when Menton was associated with Monaco.

The surrounding square and old-town streets preserve a very different atmosphere from the grand resort buildings along the waterfront.

### Palais de Carnolès

The former princely residence of Monaco's ruling family provides another architectural connection.

Its history includes royal use, later transformations and its eventual conversion into a fine-arts museum.

Current restriction: the museum is closed for restoration. The municipal notice checked on 3 November 2026 limits the garden to weekends, 10 a.m.–noon and 2–6 p.m. The municipal page could not be retrieved again on 4 November, so reconfirm before travel; this is not a fresh confirmation of opening.

### E-1027 and the modern villa

At Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, Eileen Gray's E-1027 represents a radically different approach to domestic architecture.

The house is associated with modernist design, practical experimentation and an attempt to integrate the building with the daily lives of its inhabitants.

The operator’s published 2026 guided-visit season ran from 1 April to 31 October. That season has ended; no later session is confirmed here. Reserve only an actually announced session. The site involves walking and steps and is not a guaranteed step-free outing.

### What connects these buildings?

They were designed to meet different ideas of what life on the Riviera should be.

Religion and civic identity.

Royal prestige.

International luxury.

Modern comfort.

Artistic experimentation.

Architecture makes these changing ambitions visible.

## 10. Gardens: the art of creating a Mediterranean paradise

Book connection: Eden Tamed: The Art of Cultivation

The Riviera's gardens may seem natural, but many are the result of extraordinary intervention.

Owners imported plants from different continents, reshaped slopes, constructed terraces and developed elaborate irrigation systems.

The mild climate made ambitious collections possible.

But the gardens required labour, money and specialist knowledge.

### Visit: Val Rahmeh, Menton

The botanical garden at Val Rahmeh offers an excellent introduction to the region's history of plant collecting and acclimatisation.

Its development is associated with British owners and later the botanist Maybud Sherwood Campbell.

The garden's collections include plants from different climatic regions.

On the official page checked 4 November 2026, Val Rahmeh is closed for works through 27 November, with reopening announced for 28 November. Do not plan a visit during that closure.

### Visit: Serre de la Madone

The Serre de la Madone garden, created by Lawrence Johnston, offers another perspective on garden design.

Its terraces and planted spaces reveal the relationship between architectural composition and horticulture. The operator announces annual closure in November and December 2026; this specific notice takes precedence here over the page’s generic opening panel. The terrain includes steep and rocky paths and many steps.

### Beyond Menton: Villa Ephrussi de Rothschild

The famous gardens at Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat represent a different kind of landscape ambition.

They were developed around the collecting interests and tastes of Béatrice Ephrussi de Rothschild. Check winter opening times and the announced exceptional closure on 14 December 2026.

### What should you notice?

Don't look only at flowers.

Look at stairs, walls, water systems, views and the relationship between planted areas and surrounding buildings.

The garden is an artwork, but also a maintained environment that changes over time.

A beautiful historic garden is never simply frozen at the moment of its creation.

## 11. The hilltop Riviera: places beyond the fashionable coast

Book connection: Hilltops and Islands: Tall Stories from the Back Country

One of the most useful features of Hale's book is that it doesn't stop at the shoreline.

The inland villages reveal another Riviera.

These settlements have different histories and physical environments from the wealthy coastal resort towns.

Their streets may be steep.

Their public transport can be limited.

And their cultural identity is not simply an extension of the luxury tourism economy.

### Sainte-Agnès, Gorbio and Castellar

All three are close to Menton, but they offer distinct experiences.

Sainte-Agnès is known for its dramatic elevated position.

Gorbio has a quieter village atmosphere and narrow historic streets.

Castellar provides views towards the coast and a compact historic centre.

### What does this add to a cultural history?

It challenges the idea that the Riviera is only a strip of beaches and hotels.

The coast has always depended on connections with the surrounding hills, agriculture, routes of movement and inland communities.

### A practical suggestion

Choose one village for a half-day visit rather than trying to see several on a single rushed excursion.

Confirm public transport and return connections in advance.

Steep streets and uneven surfaces are common.

## 11. La Riviera des villages perchés

Le dernier ensemble thématique ne s'arrête pas au rivage. L'arrière-pays possède ses histoires, son agriculture, ses routes et des identités qui ne prolongent pas simplement celles des stations luxueuses.

### Sainte-Agnès, Gorbio et Castellar

Sainte-Agnès se distingue par sa position élevée ; Gorbio par ses ruelles et son atmosphère villageoise ; Castellar par son centre ancien compact et les vues vers le littoral. Proches de Menton, ils ne constituent pas pour autant une visite unique facile.

Choisissez un village pour une demi-journée. Confirmez les transports et surtout le retour. Pentes et sols irréguliers sont fréquents ; aucun accès sans marches n'est garanti. Ces lieux rappellent les relations constantes entre côte et communautés des collines.

## 11. La Riviera dei villaggi sulle colline

Il racconto non termina sulla spiaggia. L'entroterra ha storie, agricoltura, percorsi e identità che non sono semplici estensioni delle località di lusso.

### Sainte-Agnès, Gorbio e Castellar

Sainte-Agnès si distingue per la posizione elevata, Gorbio per le vie storiche e l'atmosfera raccolta, Castellar per il centro compatto e le vedute verso la costa. La vicinanza a Mentone non li rende una singola escursione semplice.

Scegli un villaggio per mezza giornata. Conferma trasporto e ritorno. Pendenze e superfici irregolari sono frequenti, senza garanzia di itinerario privo di gradini. Questi luoghi ricordano i legami fra costa e comunità delle colline.

The book covers a much wider geographical area than can be explored during a normal holiday.

For visitors based in Menton, these five excursions provide a manageable introduction to its themes.

These itineraries are original AzurMenton recommendations organised around the subjects of Hale's book. They are not routes supplied by the author. Durations are editorial estimates, not measured transfer times or accessibility assessments. Monaco and La Turbie may be more comfortable on separate days. No current bus departure or return is guaranteed.

### If you have only one day

Stay in Menton.

Begin with the old town and Saint-Michel.

Walk towards the historic seafront and Belle Époque buildings.

Visit an open garden or museum whose history interests you.

You can experience several centuries of the region's cultural transformation without leaving town.

### If you have three days

Choose Menton, Monaco and Nice.

This gives you three contrasting examples of Riviera identity.

A historic border town transformed by winter tourism.

A small sovereign state associated with international wealth.

And a large Mediterranean city shaped by Roman settlement, international communities and modern artistic life.

### If you have a week

Add Juan-les-Pins and one hilltop village.

The result is a broader understanding of the coast without needing to travel constantly.

## 13. What this book adds beyond an ordinary travel guide

Most tourist guides organise a destination according to what the visitor can do.

Beaches.

Restaurants.

Museums.

Gardens.

Hotels.

Hale asks a different question.

Why are those things here in the first place?

Why did particular foreigners choose the Riviera?

How did painters and writers shape its international reputation?

How did architecture and landscape design turn private ambitions into public heritage?

Why do we continue associating the coast with luxury even when much of its history has very little to do with luxury?

These questions make the region more interesting.

A grand hotel becomes part of the history of international winter tourism.

A garden becomes evidence of scientific curiosity and personal ambition.

A casino becomes part of the transformation of a sovereign state.

A church becomes a reminder of political and cultural traditions older than the modern border.

The familiar tourist landscape begins to acquire depth.

## 13. Ce que le livre apporte au-delà d'un guide touristique

Un guide ordinaire classe ce que l'on peut faire : plages, restaurants, musées, hôtels. Hale invite à demander pourquoi ces lieux existent ici, pourquoi certains étrangers sont venus et comment art et architecture ont transformé des ambitions privées en patrimoine.

L'hôtel devient une trace de l'hivernage international ; le jardin, de la curiosité scientifique et des ressources de son propriétaire ; le casino, de la transformation d'un État ; l'église, de traditions plus anciennes que la frontière actuelle. Le paysage touristique gagne ainsi de la profondeur, sans que le luxe résume toute son histoire.

## 13. Che cosa aggiunge rispetto a una guida turistica

L'hotel diventa una testimonianza della villeggiatura invernale; il giardino della curiosità scientifica e delle risorse del proprietario; il casinò della trasformazione di uno Stato; la chiesa di tradizioni precedenti al confine attuale. Il paesaggio turistico acquista profondità, senza ridurre tutta la storia al lusso.

### Before visiting Nice

Read about Russian residents, French cultural figures and the development of painting, music and cinema.

### Before exploring the hilltop villages

Read the concluding chapter on inland settlements and islands.

It provides a useful reminder that the Riviera isn't limited to its coastal resorts.

### A useful reading habit

After visiting a place, return to the relevant section.

You may notice details that meant little before you saw the building, garden or landscape for yourself.

## 15. How does Julian Hale compare with Michael Nelson?

Readers interested in Riviera history may also encounter Michael Nelson's The French Riviera: A History.

The books complement one another, but their emphasis is different.

|  | Julian Hale | Michael Nelson |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Book | The French Riviera: A Cultural History | The French Riviera: A History |
| Main approach | Cultural themes, international communities, art, architecture and gardens | Broad chronological regional history |
| Particularly useful for | Understanding the Riviera's image and cultural heritage | Establishing a historical timeline |
| Suggested travel use | Choose a theme and visit related places | Follow a historical period across different towns |

Neither should be treated as a complete academic reference.

Hale's book is especially rewarding for readers who want to connect cultural history with the places they can still explore.

Nelson provides a broader chronological framework.

Read together, they help explain both how the Riviera changed and how it came to be imagined.

## 16. What readers should keep in mind

A cultural history written in 2009 reflects the sources, interpretations and heritage conditions available at the time.

Some attractions have since changed their visiting arrangements.

Museums may close for restoration.

Gardens may require reservations.

Properties may become private or reopen after conservation work.

### Cultural interpretation isn't the same as a complete social history

The lives of wealthy visitors, artists and famous expatriates are particularly well documented.

But they don't represent everyone who lived on the Riviera.

The region's international image depended on local workers, agricultural communities, service industries and the development of infrastructure.

A complete understanding requires attention to those lives too.

### Anecdotes need context

Hale includes lively stories about famous visitors.

These make the book enjoyable, but memorable anecdotes should not automatically be treated as conclusive historical evidence.

For detailed research, consult the sources listed in the book and relevant institutional archives.

### The Riviera isn't culturally uniform

Menton, Monaco, Nice, Antibes and inland villages have different histories.

Their languages, political relationships and patterns of development are not interchangeable.

One of the pleasures of travelling through the region is discovering those differences.
fr:
## 16. Les limites à garder en tête

Un texte de 2009 reflète les sources et interprétations de son époque. Les conditions de visite ont changé : restaurations, réservations, propriétés privées ou réouvertures. Une édition récemment répertoriée ne suffit pas à actualiser ces informations.

Les célébrités, riches voyageurs et artistes sont particulièrement documentés, mais ne représentent pas toute la population. Travailleurs, agriculture, services et infrastructures comptent tout autant. Les anecdotes ne constituent pas automatiquement une preuve historique décisive ; consultez bibliographie et archives pour approfondir.

Enfin, Menton, Monaco, Nice, Antibes et les villages n'ont ni les mêmes langues, ni les mêmes histoires politiques, ni le même développement. La découverte de ces différences fait partie du plaisir du voyage.

## 16. Limiti da ricordare

Un testo del 2009 riflette fonti e interpretazioni dell'epoca. Nel frattempo sono cambiate visite, restauri, prenotazioni e proprietà. La presenza di una nuova scheda editoriale non aggiorna automaticamente queste condizioni.

Celebrità, artisti e visitatori ricchi sono particolarmente documentati ma non rappresentano tutta la popolazione. Lavoratori, agricoltura, servizi e infrastrutture contano altrettanto. Un aneddoto memorabile non è automaticamente una prova storica decisiva: per approfondire servono bibliografia e archivi.

Mentone, Monaco, Nizza, Antibes e i villaggi hanno lingue, rapporti politici e percorsi diversi. Scoprire le differenze è parte del piacere del viaggio.

## 16. Про які межі варто пам'ятати

Текст 2009 року відображає тодішні джерела й інтерпретації. Відтоді змінилися реставрації, бронювання, власність і доступ. Новий бібліографічний запис автоматично не оновлює ці умови.

Заможні гості, знаменитості та митці добре документовані, але не представляють усе населення. Працівники, сільське господарство, послуги й інфраструктура не менш важливі. Яскравий анекдот не стає автоматично вирішальним історичним доказом: для дослідження потрібні бібліографія й архіви.

Ментон, Монако, Ніцца, Антіб і гірські села мають різні мови, політичні зв'язки та шляхи розвитку. Відкривати ці відмінності — частина задоволення від подорожі.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is The French Riviera: A Cultural History about?

Julian Hale explores the region through its history, international communities, writers, artists, architecture, gardens and cultural landscape.

### Who is Julian Hale?

A writer and broadcaster whose publisher describes him as dividing his time between London and Menton.

### When was the book published?

The original edition appeared in 2009, including Oxford University Press catalogue records. Google Books lists an Andrews UK Limited edition dated 24 March 2026; that listing does not establish revised content or current visitor advice.

### Is the book specifically about Menton?

No. It covers the wider Riviera, but Menton and the eastern coast are significant parts of its geographical and cultural landscape.

### Is this a conventional guidebook?

No. It's a cultural history with places and historical references, rather than a current directory of attractions, ticket prices and transport schedules.

### Does the book cover artists and writers?

Yes. Its chapters include French and foreign writers, major painters, musicians, film culture and the development of the Riviera's artistic reputation.

### Does it discuss gardens?

Yes. One chapter is devoted to the history and cultural significance of gardens and cultivation along the coast.

### Is the book suitable for first-time visitors?

Yes, particularly for readers who want to understand more than the usual tourist attractions. You can read selected thematic chapters before individual excursions.

### Can you follow the book from Menton without a car?

Several suggested outings are possible using regional trains and local buses, but destinations such as La Turbie and some hilltop villages require more careful transport planning.

### What's the difference between this book and Michael Nelson's history?

Hale places greater emphasis on cultural traditions and the image of the region, while Nelson provides a broader chronological account.

## Final thoughts: learning to see a familiar coast differently

The French Riviera is one of the most recognisable landscapes in Europe.

Its blue sea and palm trees have become shorthand for an entire idea of pleasure.

But every famous image has a history.

The hotels were built for particular visitors.

The gardens were planted by people with ambitions, resources and specialised knowledge.

The artists arrived for different reasons.

The borders moved.

The towns changed.

And the cultural image of the Riviera was created over generations.

Julian Hale's The French Riviera: A Cultural History helps readers look beyond the postcard.

For visitors staying in Menton, that is especially rewarding.

You can begin with a historic church, walk past a former grand hotel, explore a garden shaped by international residents and then travel a short distance to a completely different political and cultural environment.

The Riviera remains beautiful.

But after reading its cultural history, the beauty becomes only the beginning of the story.
fr:
## Pour conclure : apprendre à regarder autrement

Mer bleue et palmiers évoquent le plaisir, mais toute image célèbre possède une histoire. Hôtels, jardins, artistes, frontières et villes résultent de choix et de changements. Hale aide à regarder derrière la carte postale.

Depuis Menton, une église ancienne, un ancien grand hôtel et un jardin autorisé suffisent déjà à poser ces questions. Une excursion conduit ensuite à une autre identité politique et culturelle. La beauté reste là ; elle devient le début de l'histoire plutôt que son résumé.

## Conclusione: imparare a guardare diversamente

Mare azzurro e palme evocano piacere, ma ogni immagine famosa ha una storia. Hotel, giardini, artisti, confini e città derivano da scelte e trasformazioni. Hale invita a guardare oltre la cartolina.

Da Mentone una chiesa, un antico albergo e un giardino accessibile nella data scelta bastano già a porre nuove domande. Una gita conduce poi a un'altra identità politica e culturale. La bellezza rimane, ma diventa l'inizio del racconto invece della sua conclusione.

Синє море й пальми стали символами насолоди, але кожен відомий образ має історію. Готелі, сади, художники, кордони й міста — наслідок рішень та змін. Гейл допомагає зазирнути за листівку.
